record.name: Force Choke

mastery_check.description: A Light-aligned user may resist the sadistic urge to crush life through supreme compassion.

record.narrative: You reach out through the dark side and seize your victim's throat with invisible fingers of pure malevolence. The power manifests as a crushing grip that closes their windpipe, their eyes bulging in terror as they claw futilely at their neck, unable to break free from your telekinetic stranglehold. This is domination through the Force at its most visceral and cruel.
record.flavor_text: "You have failed me for the last time." - Darth Vader

base_effect.description: You reach out with the dark side and constrict your target's throat, cutting off their air supply.

mechanics.notes: Constitution save or take 2d6 force damage
Cannot speak or cast powers requiring verbal components
2d6 force damage at start of target's turn

class_synergies.narrative: For a Guardian to use Force Choke is an act of utter desperation or complete fall, turning their protective instincts inside out to become an instrument of suffering. This violation of their core values grants them terrifying efficiency in the application.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians gain +1 to Force power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human emotional intensity and capacity for both love and hatred makes Force Choke particularly potent in their hands, their rage focusing the crushing grip with merciless precision.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Sith have perfected Force Choke as a tool of fear and domination, their dark teachings emphasizing the psychological terror it inflicts as much as the physical damage.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi gain +2 to Force power saving throw DCs.

resonance_effects.narrative_trigger: Used to dominate a helpless or terrified foe.

bystander_effect.narrative_trigger: A companion witnesses this act of cruelty and does not intervene.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the victim's terror as invisible fingers close around their throat. Their hands fly to their neck, clawing at nothing. Their face turns red, then purple, eyes bulging as they struggle for air that won't come. Gasping, choking sounds escape their crushed windpipe. The dark side user's hand mimics the grip, fingers slowly closing as they savor their victim's suffering.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Force Choke combines damage-over-time with silence effects, making it devastating against spellcasters. The concentration requirement means you're vulnerable while maintaining it. The 30-foot range keeps you at medium distance. Most effective against isolated targets where you can maintain concentration.
narrative_hooks: Vader executes an incompetent officer from across the room during a hologram conference
A fallen Jedi uses Force Choke in a moment of rage, sealing their corruption
The power is interrupted at the last second, saving the victim from death
